details: ssite-mock-server is a dependency-confusion package with no functional code (its description is "Authorized Test Package"). Its postinstall script runs `node ./index.cjs` on npm install, which POSTs the hostname, home directory, platform and CI provider (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines or Jenkins) to `https://130.162.231.177:8443/`. It was published by the npm account notsemz, which published two more packages with the same beacon on 2026-10-29 and seven placeholder-only names.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
